yes! would love to! :smiley: 

unfortunately my coming week is looking a bit busy so I'll likely won't be able to look into this in the next coming few days, but later in the week or at the latest next weekend I can definitely spend time on it, so if that's ok, I'm all for making the change :smile:

component in the TestBed.configureTestingModule's declarations array,
by making more clear the fact that this error originated from the
TestBed call
